verdict.rationale: Lium's own docs cover only one slice of the story, data handling: pod volumes are encrypted at rest by default on the default templates, and local volumes are backed up every 6 hours and kept for 2 days. Nothing in the evidence lets a platform engineer verify SOC 2 or other compliance attestations, or the datacenter tiers behind the marketplace's GPU nodes. missing for 10: SOC 2 or other compliance certifications, datacenter tier and provider vetting documentation, a trust center or security whitepaper, a data residency and retention policy, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can verify the provider's security and compliance posture (SOC 2, data handling, datacenter tiers) before putting proprietary models on it

citations.quote: pod volumes encrypted at rest by default on the default templates
the pod's local volume is backed up every 6 hours and kept 2 days, so you can restore it on another node
